app.name: PaycheckZero
app.tagline: Paycheck-first zero-based budgeting: give every paycheck a job, down to the last cent.
auth.register_intro: Budget one paycheck at a time. Your month adds itself up.
auth.cookie_blocked: You signed in, but this browser didn't keep the sign-in cookie. Allow cookies for this site (and, if the server uses PZ_SECURE_COOKIES=true, open it with https://), then try again.
auth.check_fields: Check your email and password and try again.
budget.title: Budget
spend.title: Transactions
assign.title: Assign from the {date} paycheck
plan.empty_title: This paycheck hasn't been given any jobs yet
plan.empty_body: Tap Assign to choose what it pays for, or add a new line below. Budget shows the whole month.
budget.empty_cats: Empty categories — tap to add a line:
paycheck.actual_hint: Income transactions tagged to this paycheck fill this in automatically.
newline.optional: Optional. You can plan it later.
theme.button_system: Theme: follows your device. Switch to light
theme.button_dark: Theme: dark. Switch to follow your device
theme.title: Appearance
theme.body: Follow your device, or pick light or dark for this device.
offline.banner: You're offline. You can still view this page and record transactions; they'll sync when you reconnect.
offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: This page hasn't been saved for offline use yet. Reconnect and try again.
error.no_scripts: This browser couldn't start PaycheckZero's scripts, so buttons may not respond. Update your browser (Chrome 93+, Safari 15.4+, Firefox 92+) or turn off content blockers for this site.
error.load_body: Check your connection and try again. Your data is safe.
status.label: Month status
status.zero: Every dollar has a job. This month is at zero.
over.category: A line in this category is over plan
over.sts: {amount} of spending from this paycheck wasn't in its plan.
status.no_income: No income yet — add a paycheck to start planning this month.
status.zero_with_variance: At zero on plan, but a paycheck came in different — see below.
status.over_assigned: Assigned {amount} more than this month's income
status.locked: Locked — planning is frozen; actuals and transactions still work.
status.locked_toast: Month locked. Nice work — every dollar has a job.
status.relocked_toast: Variance resolved. The month is locked again.
status.reassigning: Variance re-assignment is open: you can move allocations until the month is back at zero.
status.archived: This month is archived. Restore it from your months list to make changes.
variance.title: A paycheck came in different than planned
variance.steps: Steps to get back to zero
variance.step_open_hint: Re-opens allocation editing only; everything else stays locked.
variance.step_apply: Use each paycheck's actual as its planned amount.
variance.step_balance: Re-balance your lines until the month is back at zero.
variance.net: Net difference between actual and planned income: {amount}.
variance.applied: Planned amount updated to the actual. Re-balance any lines shown above.
paycheck.heading: Paycheck {date} — {name}
paycheck.nudge: Give every dollar a job: {amount} of this paycheck is still unassigned.
paycheck.all_assigned_hint: To fund something else, lower another line first.
paycheck.skipped_notice: This paycheck is skipped. It adds no income and funds nothing.
paycheck.empty_body: Choose a line below (or create one) and assign money from this paycheck.
paycheck.skip_confirm: Skip this paycheck? All money it funds will be un-assigned.
paycheck.delete_confirm: Delete this paycheck? All money it funds will be un-assigned.
targets.title: Last month's plan
fund.title: Assign money from this paycheck
col.name: Name
line.delete_confirm: Delete {name}? Its funding will be un-assigned and its transactions unlinked.
line.add_amount_label: Amount for the new line in {category}
line.add_paycheck_label: Paycheck that funds the new line in {category}
line.add_from_this_label: Amount from this paycheck for the new line in {category}
category.delete_confirm: Delete {name} and all its lines? Their funding will be un-assigned.
overview.title: {month} overview
overview.explain: Totals here are built from your paycheck decisions. Changing a Planned amount here adjusts the underlying paycheck allocations (earliest paycheck with money free first).
overview.no_income_body: Add a paycheck first — every plan starts with what a paycheck will fund.
cards.label: Month summary
cards.spent_meter: Share of planned spending already spent
onboarding.title: Welcome! Start with your paycheck.
onboarding.body: Add the paychecks you expect this month. Then you'll decide, paycheck by paycheck, what each one pays for.
income.title: Income
income.empty_body: Add a one-off or recurring income line; its paychecks are created automatically.
income.name: Name
income.anchor_hint: Any date you were (or will be) paid; other paydays are counted from it.
income.days_hint: Comma separated, e.g. 1, 15. Days past the month's end use the last day.
income.paycheck_added: Paycheck added. Assign its money to give every dollar a job.
income.delete_confirm: Delete {name} and its paychecks? Money they fund will be un-assigned.
schedule.semi_desc: Twice a month on the {a} and {b}
tx.title: {month} transactions
tx.paycheck_hint: Tag a paycheck: spending counts against its Safe to Spend; income is recorded as that paycheck actually received.
tx.empty_body: Record spending as it happens; link it to a line to track Spent.
split.title: Split a transaction
split.intro: One payment across several lines or paychecks, e.g. a store run that was part groceries, part household.
split.delete_confirm: Delete this split transaction and all its parts?
tx.locked_ok: This month is locked. You can still record transactions.
report.title: Insights
report.see_compare: Compare with last month and last year
report.drill_hint: Tip: select a category name to show its lines.
report.trend_note: “—” means no budget exists for that month.
report.payee_empty_body: Pick a different date range, or record some transactions.
report.export_tx_body: Every transaction across all your months between two dates, one row each (split parts included).
chart.donut_label: {title}, total {total}. Values are listed in the legend.
chart.dti_detail: {pay} planned for debt out of {income} planned income.
chart.debt_balance: Total debt balance {amount} ({months}× this month's income).
chart.dti_guide: Guide: under 15% is comfortable; over 36% is high.
chart.savings_guide: Guide: 20% or more is strong; under 10% is low.
report.chart_empty: Nothing planned or spent yet this month.
report.no_data: No budget exists for {month}, so there is nothing to compare yet.
months.title: Your months
months.intro: Plan any month — past, present or future.
months.empty_body: Create a month to start planning your paychecks.
months.archived_toast: Month archived. You can restore it any time.
months.delete_warning: This permanently deletes {month} and everything in it. This cannot be undone.
copy.structure_desc: Categories and lines from another month; nothing planned.
copy.planned_desc: Categories, lines and last plan as targets; you re-assign them across this month's paychecks.
restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.body: Upload a full-month snapshot (.json) exported from PaycheckZero.
restore.replace: Replace the month if it already exists
export.title: Export
settings.title: Settings
settings.logout_all_confirm: Sign out everywhere, including this device?
settings.currency_explain: Changing it converts every amount in every month using the rate you enter.
settings.rate_hint: Units of the new currency per 1 unit of the current one, e.g. 0.92.
settings.currency_confirm: Convert every amount in every month with this rate?
impact.rebalance: Re-balance the {amount} difference to get back to zero.
impact.deleted_funding: Deleted funding went back to its paychecks. Re-assign it to get back to zero.
sync.conflict: This changed on another device while you were offline.
err.over_allocated_dated: That would over-allocate the {date} paycheck by {amount}.
err.insufficient: There isn't enough unassigned paycheck money: you're {amount} short. Add income or lower another line first.
err.transfer_exceeds: Only {amount} is assigned there to move.
err.not_zero_left: You can't lock yet: {amount} is still unassigned. Give it a job first.
err.not_zero_over: You can't lock yet: you've assigned {amount} more than your income.
err.non_positive: Amounts must be greater than zero. To stop funding a line, set it to 0 or delete it.
err.split_too_few: A split needs at least two parts with amounts.
err.split_mixed: All parts of a split must be the same type (all expense or all income).
err.split_total: The parts add up to {parts}, but the total is {total}. Adjust a part so they match.
err.zero_transaction: A transaction needs an amount other than zero.
err.locked: This month is locked. Planned amounts and allocations are frozen; use variance re-assignment to adjust.
err.not_locked: Only a locked month can be re-assigned.
err.not_reassigning: Variance re-assignment isn't open for this month.
err.no_variance: There is no paycheck variance to re-assign.
err.unresolved_variance: The {date} paycheck's actual still differs from its plan. Use its actual as planned first.
err.no_actual: Record the amount actually received first.
err.skipped: This paycheck is skipped and can't fund anything.
err.duplicate_paycheck: There's already a paycheck from this income on {date}.
err.no_dates: That schedule has no paydays in this month.
err.invalid_name: Names must be between 1 and {max} characters.
err.not_debt: Only lines in a Debt category have a balance and minimum payment.
err.not_found: We couldn't find that. It may have been deleted.
err.invariant: That change would break a budget rule, so it wasn't saved.
err.registration_closed: This PaycheckZero already has its account. Sign in instead.
err.archived: This month is archived. Restore it to make changes.
err.month_exists: You already have a budget for that month.
err.stale: This month changed in another tab. We reloaded the latest version; please try again.
err.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match.
err.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Your change wasn't saved; please try again.
err.password_short: Use a password of at least 8 characters.
err.days: Enter days of the month as numbers, like 1, 15.
err.semi_days: Twice a month needs exactly two days, like 1, 15.
err.rate: Enter a positive exchange rate like 0.92.
err.source_required: Choose which month to copy from.
err.delete_confirm: Type the month exactly as shown to confirm permanent deletion.
err.snapshot_format: That file isn't a PaycheckZero month snapshot.
err.snapshot_currency: That snapshot uses a different currency than your account.
client.over_allocated: That's {amount} more than this paycheck has left.
client.queued: Saved offline. It will sync when you're back online.
client.conflicts: {n} offline change(s) conflict with newer data.
client.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
client.back_online: You're back online. Open it again to make changes.
client.theme_system: Theme: follows your device. Switch to light
client.theme_dark: Theme: dark. Switch to follow your device
client.online_only: This needs a connection. Try again when you're back online.
client.split_mismatch: The parts don't add up to the total yet.
accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.summary_note: Balances add up every transaction on each account. Check them against your bank now and then.
accounts.add_sub: A bank account, cash, a credit card, or a retirement or investment account.
accounts.archived: Account archived. Its history stays in your transactions.
accounts.archive_confirm: Archive {name}? It disappears from lists, but its transactions stay.
accounts.empty_body: Add your checking, savings, cash and credit cards. Tag transactions with the account they used and PaycheckZero keeps each balance up to date.
accounts.name: Account name
accounts.balance_hint: From your bank app. Overdrawn? Start with a minus sign.
accounts.reconcile_hint: If it differs, PaycheckZero records the difference as an adjustment so the balance matches.
accounts.reconciled_adjusted: Adjusted by {amount} to match your bank.
accounts.no_tx: No transactions on this account yet.
accounts.prompt: Add your bank accounts and cards to see real balances next to your plan.
cards.explain: Card purchases count against their budget lines like any other spending. That money is ready to pay the card; anything beyond it is carried debt.
cards.ready_explain: {amount} of {month}'s card spending was on budget lines, so the money is already set aside. Pay it off to avoid interest.
cards.carried_explain: {amount} is carried debt. Plan a payment on a Debt line and link it when you pay.
cards.needs_line_explain: {amount} of card spending this month has no line yet, so it isn't set aside. Give those transactions a line.
cards.minimum_due: Minimum payment: {amount} still to pay this month.
cards.utilization: Using {pct}% of your limit. Under 30% is best for your credit score.
cards.reconcile_label: Amount owed in your card app
err.account_in_use: This account has transactions. Archive it instead.
err.goal_month: Pick the month you want to reach this goal.
err.goal_no_debt: That debt is already paid off.
err.goal_past: Pick a month from this one onward.
err.invalid_transfer: A transfer needs two different accounts.
goal.title: Goals
goal.new_sub: Save toward something, or pay off a debt.
goal.delete_confirm: Delete the goal {name}? Your budget isn't changed.
goal.empty: Set a goal (an emergency fund, a trip, paying off a card) and watch it grow month by month.
goal.name: Goal name
goal.track_save_hint: A budget line counts what you plan on it each month. An account counts its balance.
goal.track_payoff_hint: Progress is how much the balance has come down.
goal.bars_label: Progress each month, last six months
goal.on_track_explain: {amount} this month covers the {need} needed. {n} month(s) to go.
goal.behind_explain: {amount} this month; {need} is needed to stay on pace. {n} month(s) to go.
goal.no_date_explain: {amount} this month. Add a date to see the pace you need.
plan.recent_empty: Nothing spent from this paycheck yet. Tap + to add a transaction.
transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.sub: Move money between your accounts, or pay a card.
transfer.instead: Moving money between accounts? Make a transfer
transfer.line_hint: Link a line when this transfer is planned in your budget: a debt payment you didn't budget as purchases, or saving you plan for, like a Roth IRA. Leave it empty for paying card spending that's already in your budget.
tx.tap_to_add_line: Tap to give it a line
tx.all_have_lines_body: Nothing to sort. Your spending all counts against the plan.
invest.explain: Market ups and downs are recorded as growth, never as spending. Contributions taken out of your paycheck don't touch your budget; money you move in from checking is a transfer.
invest.update_hint: The difference is recorded as market growth (or loss), not spending.
invest.contribution_hint: For money taken out of your paycheck before it reaches you, like a 401(k). It doesn't affect your budget.
invest.delete_confirm: Delete this entry? The balance will change by the same amount.
